summary: Fix Phase 1 accessibility violations, send button regression, and draft lifecycle correctness issues
approach: Group fixes by file to minimize merge conflicts: Wave 1 fixes ChatAreaComposer.tsx (a11y + send + correctness) and ChatArea.tsx (debounce/draft) in parallel; Wave 2 updates tests for both
design_decisions: Use tabIndex={-1} instead of aria-hidden for Trash2 (WCAG compliant, keeps button in DOM)
Add sr-only live region for copy announcement (reliable across NVDA/VoiceOver)
Add cancel() to makeDebounce to prevent stale timer writes

patterns: opacity-0 + pointer-events-none + tabIndex={-1} for visually hidden but DOM-present buttons
sr-only + role='status' + aria-live='polite' for screen reader announcements
conventions: focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary-500/50 for toolbar buttons

gaps_deferred: 42+ architecture/maintainability items (ISS-002 through ISS-060) deferred to future phases
